correctness.rationale: The three exact Cartier eigenvalues follow from the explicit differential basis and exponent extraction. The B and F universal coefficient identities are proved by Lucas divisibility, a hypergeometric coefficient ODE and leading coefficient comparison. The nonvanishing discriminant factors force ordinary or zero Cartier on the Prym and ordinary elliptic quotient. A second-order ODE with p>degree gives simple roots outside the singular boundary, and the marked coefficient scaling gives the class count. Nine prime formal coefficient checks and complete small-prime rational-point trace checks corroborate, without replacing universal proof.
